note: Ask A of issue 4763: 'DXC doesn't report an error when placing a resource in a ConstantBuffer'. The symptom is an ABSENCE, so this is deliberately NOT an absence-only predicate. Clause 4 alone would be satisfied for free by any release that failed to compile the repro for an unrelated reason -- that release emitted no diagnostic about resources-in-cbuffers either, and would score as a perfect reproduction while having measured nothing. Clauses 1-3 are the anti-vacuity anchors and none of them can be produced by a compile that did not finish: (1) the entry point was lowered to DXIL; (2) all four cbuffers were created and bound, so codegen ran to resource binding; (3) the cbuffer holding the StructuredBuffer<float3>-bearing struct was laid out as 16 bytes, which can only happen if the resource member was present inside it and was accounted for. Clause 3 is the clause that makes control-resources-global.hlsl fail: that control is the same program with the resources moved out of the cbuffer structs to file scope, and its __cbModelData2 is Size 4. Clause 3 is also what makes the predicate non-vacuous on a shader that declares no resource inside a cbuffer at all. Note the deliberate coupling: on the reporter's exact shader the buffers are never read, so DXC drops them entirely and the ONLY portable in-output evidence that the construct was accepted is the space they left behind in the cbuffer layout. variant-resources-used.hlsl shows the other half (hoisted 'cbModelData2.bufferData ... texture struct r/o T0 t0' binding rows) but is not the reporter's shader. Consequence for future re-scoring: a release that both starts diagnosing the construct AND changes the layout flips clauses 3 and 4 together, so a no-match must be read from the capture rather than assumed to mean 'fixed'. Instrument portability was checked before this was written: '%hostlayout.' (main) is spelled '%dx.alignment.legacy.' on v1.4.1907 and would have false-negatived the oldest release, so it is deliberately not used; clauses 1-3 were confirmed present verbatim in both v1.4.1907 and main output. Controls: control-resources-global.hlsl (correct code, expect no-match) and control-cbv-array.hlsl (POSITIVE control -- a resource in a ConstantBuffer view array, which DXC does diagnose, expect no-match), plus control-hello.hlsl as a per-release feature-presence probe.
